annotation.authors_or_issuer: African Commission on Human and Peoples' Rights (ACHPR)
key_provisions_or_claims: Calls on States to ensure AI and robotics are compatible with the African Charter and uphold dignity, privacy, equality, transparency and accountability
Urges adaptation of imported technologies to African context and inclusion of African values such as Ubuntu
Appeals that AI and robotics with far-reaching human consequences remain under meaningful human control, to be codified as a human rights principle
Calls on the AU and regional bodies to develop a regional regulatory framework
Commits the Commission to a study with an African Group of Experts on AI and new technologies
annotation.summary_en: ACHPR Resolution 473 (2021) calls on African States to ensure AI, robotics and emerging technologies comply with the African Charter, urges transparency and inclusion of African values, calls for a regional regulatory framework, and appeals for meaningful human control to be codified as a human rights principle. It commits to a study with an expert group.
